Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-001
Rule.Description: Detects search engine crawlers accessing sensitive paths like /admin, /.env, /.git, /wp-admin, /backup, /config

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-002
Rule.Description: Detects verbose server headers disclosing technology stack versions enabling targeted attacks

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-003
Rule.Description: Detects reconnaissance of application architecture through technology-specific error pages and headers

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-004
Rule.Description: Detects directory listing responses exposing file structure and sensitive files

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-005
Rule.Description: Detects access to metadata files and source code repositories exposing implementation details

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-006
Rule.Description: Detects verbose error messages leaking stack traces, database details, or internal paths

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-007
Rule.Description: Detects sensitive data such as tokens, passwords, and PII transmitted in URL query parameters

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-008
Rule.Description: Detects HTTP OPTIONS responses revealing dangerous methods like PUT, DELETE, TRACE, or DEBUG

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-009
Rule.Description: Detects CORS headers with wildcard origins or origin reflection enabling cross-origin data theft

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-010
Rule.Description: Detects responses missing Content-Security-Policy headers or with overly permissive CSP directives

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-011
Rule.Description: Detects responses missing critical security headers like Strict-Transport-Security, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-012
Rule.Description: Detects dangling CNAME records pointing to unclaimed external services enabling subdomain takeover

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-013
Rule.Description: Detects enumeration of cloud storage buckets (S3, GCS, Azure Blob) for data exposure

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-014
Rule.Description: Detects unauthorized access to API documentation endpoints like /swagger, /api-docs, /openapi.json

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-015
Rule.Description: Detects access to debug endpoints, test pages, or development tools left in production

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-016
Rule.Description: Detects login attempts using default credentials on network devices, firewalls, and routers

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-017
Rule.Description: Detects login error messages that differentiate between invalid username and invalid password

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-018
Rule.Description: Detects account creation events bypassing approval workflows

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-019
Rule.Description: Detects unauthorized role elevation during account modification including admin role grants

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG01-020
Rule.Description: Detects replay of SAML or OAuth tokens from different source IPs or outside expected time windows
